FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Market Grocers
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Fresh Market Blvd, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62701-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fresh Market Grocers operates as a retail grocery store serving the community with a wide range of products including fresh produce, dairy, canned goods, frozen foods, and household essentials. Our store spans over 3,000 square feet, allowing us to maintain a diverse inventory that meets the needs of our customers. We employ a trained staff and conduct regular inspections to ensure our operations align with industry standards. Our efficient inventory management systems help reduce spoilage and ensure product availability. We also emphasize cleanliness and organization in our store layout, which enhances the shopping experience while minimizing risks. Our commitment to quality is reflected in established vendor relationships that ensure we source high-quality products for our customers. Overall, our operations aim to foster a safe and customer-friendly environment.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "Fresh Market Catering LLC, a catering service focusing on healthy meal prep and delivery, and Fresh Market Organic Farms, a local farm producing organic produce for our stores."
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/10/2023, we experienced a loss of $1,500 due to a refrigeration unit malfunction, resulting in the spoilage of perishable inventory. The loss has been reported to our insurance provider, and proper preventive measures were implemented to avoid future occurrences. The status of this loss is open as we are currently awaiting reimbursement.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel, Class 2, UL Listed Fire Safe for 1 Hour, Floor Mounted Vault
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security personnel for enhanced protection against theft and property damage.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The store focuses on retail grocery activities and complies with food safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Fresh Market Grocers sponsors local athletic teams as part of our commitment to community engagement and support for youth sports programs.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The Food Safety Manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking the certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any other related crime in connection with this or any other property for Fresh Market Grocers. The business prioritizes integrity and compliance with the law.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Market Grocers has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The business has maintained continuous insurance coverage without any issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not lease employees to or from other employers, focusing on maintaining a dedicated workforce to ensure consistent service and compliance with food safety regulations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Fresh Market Grocers carries Workers Compensation insurance as part of their commitment to employee safety and compliance with legal requirements. They ensure that all employees are adequately covered under their policy.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Fresh Market Grocers owns and operates two additional businesses: Fresh Market Catering LLC, which focuses on healthy meal preparation and delivery, and Fresh Market Organic Farms, a local farm that produces organic produce for our stores.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not have any other insurance policies with this company aside from the active policy mentioned. All necessary coverage is maintained through the current insurance provider.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Market Grocers is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The store focuses solely on retail grocery operations, adhering to food safety regulations.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not rent or loan equipment to others, as the focus is solely on retail grocery operations. This helps maintain a clear scope of business and reduces potential liability risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Market Grocers has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The business maintains financial stability and compliance with obligations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on retail grocery activities without involvement in the handling of hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus on retail grocery activities with no involvement in high-risk activities that may lead to catastrophic events. We maintain a safe environment and comply with all regulatory requirements to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Market Grocers has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to compliance and employee training to prevent such issues.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Market Grocers has no uncorrected fire code violations, demonstrating compliance with all fire safety regulations to ensure the safety of the premises and customers.
